set -euo pipefail
df -Pk /tmp >&2
run_tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/gh200-cfg-c-tail-off-off-XXXXXXXX)
echo "JOB=$SLURM_JOB_ID NODE=$(hostname) RUN_TMP=$run_tmp" >&2
cd "$run_tmp"
tar -xzf -
export TMPDIR="$run_tmp/tmp" SPACK_USER_CACHE_PATH="$run_tmp/spack-cache" CUDA_CACHE_PATH="$run_tmp/cuda-cache"
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
set +e
( set -euo pipefail; romeo_load_armgpu_env; spack load cuda@12.9.0; spack load /74annk4; bash run.sh ) >run.log 2>&1
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >exit_code.txt
tar --exclude='./tmp' --exclude='./spack-cache' --exclude='./cuda-cache' -czf - .
exit "$rc"
